pd_new_teacher_mentoring_001.answer: Yes: Mentor assignment: Consulting Teachers assigned to Beginning Teachers; Duration: up to 3 years; Release time: Mentoring occurs during assigned Consulting Teacher time; Stipend: $2,000 for site-based, $500 per Beginning Teacher for released-time; Required meetings: Monthly Mentor teacher meetings.
pd_new_teacher_mentoring_001.evidence: Consulting Teachers may mentor Beginning Teachers who are not yet assigned by the first or third quarter of the school year. ... entitled to the $2,000 Mentoring differential ... earn a differential of $500 per Beginning Teacher ... Consulting Teachers will serve no more than three (3) years. ... monthly Mentor teacher meetings ... attendance at Mentor meetings.

pd_career_ladder_003.answer: Yes: Career Pathway System for Support and Related Services Personnel (S&RSP); Levels: Multiple levels with movement based on 5 criteria; Eligibility: 3 years at current level, portfolio, CEUs; Compensation: Changes upon Sept 15 request; Evaluation link: Must meet annual evaluation criteria for level.
pd_career_ladder_003.evidence: Article 10, SUPPORT AND RELATED SERVICES PERSONNEL CAREER PATHWAY SYSTEM includes 5 criteria for movement from one level to the next. ... Advanced credential/degree necessary for movement to Level 3 ... Compensation changes resulting from a change in level shall only occur if the request for movement is submitted prior to September 15. ... meet the evaluation criteria for that level during their annual evaluation.
